decisions.title: Add cross-pillar trust lifecycle
decisions.rationale: Discovery, installation, change, use and revocation span CP.4 and CP.5. A shared objective prevents each profile inventing its own state model. It adds ownership and migration cost.

requirements: Establish separate trust decisions at discovery, installation, initial approval, material change, task admission, action commitment and revocation.
Bind each decision to the component version, owner, purpose, permitted effects and expiry; invalidate affected grants after a material change.
Record the evidence and outcome of each gate and verify that retirement, offboarding and restore cannot reactivate stale authority.
decisions.validation: Trust between discovery and retirement. Compare install, update, dormant schedules and restoration. Show which decision expires at each transition.

Exercise hostile synthetic projects and preserve process, file and network observations together with a valid trusted-project control.
